mapper.sql: FROM tb_order o JOIN tb_channel ch ON ch.channel_seq = o.channel_seq JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS alloc_line_count, SUM(t.pending_qty) AS alloc_qty, COUNT(DISTINCT t.plant_seq) AS plant_count, MIN(t.plant_seq) AS plant_seq, MIN(t.plant_id) AS plant_id, MIN(t.plant_name) AS plant_name, MIN(t.org_seq) AS org_seq FROM ( SELECT l.line_seq, MIN(p.plant_seq) AS plant_seq, MIN(p.plant_id) AS plant_id, MIN(p.plant_name) AS plant_name, MIN(p.org_seq) AS org_seq, SUM(a.qty_allocated - a.qty_released) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ol.instructed_qty) FROM tb_outbound_line ol JOIN tb_outbound ob ON ob.outbound_seq = ol.outbound_seq WHERE ol.order_line_seq = l.line_seq AND ob.outbound_status <> 'CANCELED'), 0) AS pending_qty FROM tb_order_line l JOIN tb_stock_alloc a ON a.order_line_seq = l.line_seq AND a.qty_allocated > a.qty_released JOIN tb_stock s ON s.stock_seq = a.stock_seq JOIN tb_location lo ON lo.location_seq = s.location_seq JOIN tb_warehouse w ON w.warehouse_seq = lo.warehouse_seq JOIN tb_plant p ON p.plant_seq = w.plant_seq WHERE l.order_seq = o.order_seq AND l.line_status <> 'CANCELED' GROUP BY l.line_seq ) t WHERE t.pending_qty > 0 ) al ON al.alloc_qty > 0
mapper.select: SELECT l.line_seq AS order_line_seq, l.line_no AS order_line_no, l.order_seq AS order_seq, l.sku_seq AS sku_seq, k.sku_id AS sku_id, k.color_code AS color_code, k.size_code AS size_code, pr.product_name AS product_name, (SUM(a.qty_allocated - a.qty_released) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(prev.instructed_qty) FROM tb_outbound_line prev JOIN tb_outbound pob ON pob.outbound_seq = prev.outbound_seq WHERE prev.order_line_seq = l.line_seq AND pob.outbound_status <> 'CANCELED'), 0))::int AS instructed_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT lo.location_seq) > 1 THEN MIN(lo.location_id) || ' 외 ' || (COUNT(DISTINCT lo.location_seq) - 1) || '곳' ELSE MIN(lo.location_id) END AS location_hint FROM tb_order_line l JOIN tb_sku k ON k.sku_seq = l.sku_seq JOIN tb_product pr ON pr.product_seq = k.product_seq JOIN tb_stock_alloc a ON a.order_line_seq = l.line_seq AND a.qty_allocated > a.qty_released JOIN tb_stock s ON s.stock_seq = a.stock_seq JOIN tb_location lo ON lo.location_seq = s.location_seq WHERE l.order_seq = #{orderSeq} AND l.line_status <> 'CANCELED' GROUP BY l.line_seq, l.line_no, l.order_seq, l.sku_seq, k.sku_id, k.color_code, k.size_code, pr.product_name HAVING SUM(a.qty_allocated - a.qty_released) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(prev.instructed_qty) FROM tb_outbound_line prev JOIN tb_outbound pob ON pob.outbound_seq = prev.outbound_seq WHERE prev.order_line_seq = l.line_seq AND pob.outbound_status <> 'CANCELED'), 0) > 0 ORDER BY l.line_no

SELECT DISTINCT p.plant_seq FROM tb_order_line l JOIN tb_stock_alloc a ON a.order_line_seq = l.line_seq AND a.qty_allocated > a.qty_released JOIN tb_stock s ON s.stock_seq = a.stock_seq JOIN tb_location lo ON lo.location_seq = s.location_seq JOIN tb_warehouse w ON w.warehouse_seq = lo.warehouse_seq JOIN tb_plant p ON p.plant_seq = w.plant_seq WHERE l.order_seq = #{orderSeq} AND l.line_status <> 'CANCELED'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ob.outbound_seq) FROM tb_outbound_line ol JOIN tb_outbound ob ON ob.outbound_seq = ol.outbound_seq JOIN tb_order_line l ON l.line_seq = ol.order_line_seq WHERE l.order_seq = #{orderSeq} AND ob.outbound_status <> 'CANCELED'
mapper.sql: o.outbound_seq, o.outbound_no, o.plant_seq, o.outbound_status, o.single_pack, o.ship_due_date, o.instructed_by, o.instructed_at, o.shipped_by, o.shipped_at, o.canceled_by, o.canceled_at, o.cancel_reason, o.remark, o.created_by, o.created_at, o.updated_by, o.updated_at, pl.plant_id AS plant_id, pl.plant_name AS plant_name, pl.org_seq AS org_seq, iu.user_name AS instructed_by_name, ord.order_seq, ord.order_no, ord.ext_order_no, ord.receiver_name, ord.channel_name

FROM tb_outbound o JOIN tb_plant pl ON pl.plant_seq = o.plant_seq LEFT JOIN tb_user iu ON iu.user_id = o.instructed_by LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT MIN(so.order_seq) AS order_seq, MIN(so.order_no) AS order_no, MIN(so.ext_order_no) AS ext_order_no, MIN(so.receiver_name) AS receiver_name, MIN(ch.channel_name) AS channel_name FROM tb_outbound_line ol JOIN tb_order_line l ON l.line_seq = ol.order_line_seq JOIN tb_order so ON so.order_seq = l.order_seq JOIN tb_channel ch ON ch.channel_seq = so.channel_seq WHERE ol.outbound_seq = o.outbound_seq ) ord ON TRUE

, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_outbound_line l WHERE l.outbound_seq = o.outbound_seq) AS line_count , (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.instructed_qty), 0) FROM tb_outbound_line l WHERE l.outbound_seq = o.outbound_seq) AS total_instructed_qty , (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.picked_qty), 0) FROM tb_outbound_line l WHERE l.outbound_seq = o.outbound_seq) AS total_picked_qty

where.if: AND (o.outbound_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR ord.order_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR ord.ext_order_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR ord.receiver_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')

mapper.select: SELECT ol.line_seq, ol.outbound_seq, ol.line_no, ol.order_line_seq, ol.sku_seq, ol.instructed_qty, ol.picked_qty, ol.remain_qty, ol.remark, k.sku_id, k.color_code, k.size_code, pr.product_name, so.order_seq, so.order_no, l.line_no AS order_line_no, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT lo.location_seq) > 1 THEN MIN(lo.location_id) || ' 외 ' || (COUNT(DISTINCT lo.location_seq) - 1) || '곳' ELSE MIN(lo.location_id) END AS location_hint FROM tb_outbound_line ol JOIN tb_sku k ON k.sku_seq = ol.sku_seq JOIN tb_product pr ON pr.product_seq = k.product_seq JOIN tb_order_line l ON l.line_seq = ol.order_line_seq JOIN tb_order so ON so.order_seq = l.order_seq LEFT JOIN tb_stock_alloc a ON a.order_line_seq = l.line_seq AND a.qty_allocated > a.qty_released LEFT JOIN tb_stock s ON s.stock_seq = a.stock_seq LEFT JOIN tb_location lo ON lo.location_seq = s.location_seq WHERE ol.outbound_seq = #{outboundSeq} GROUP BY ol.line_seq, ol.outbound_seq, ol.line_no, ol.order_line_seq, ol.sku_seq, ol.instructed_qty, ol.picked_qty, ol.remain_qty, ol.remark, k.sku_id, k.color_code, k.size_code, pr.product_name, so.order_seq, so.order_no, l.line_no ORDER BY ol.line_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_outbound (outbound_no, plant_seq, outbound_status, single_pack, ship_due_date, instructed_by, remark, created_by) VALUES (#{outboundNo}, #{plantSeq}, #{outboundStatus}, #{singlePack}, #{shipDueDate}, #{instructedBy}, #{remark}, #{createdBy})

INSERT INTO tb_outbound_line (outbound_seq, line_no, order_line_seq, sku_seq, instructed_qty, picked_qty, remark) VALUES (#{outboundSeq}, #{lineNo}, #{orderLineSeq}, #{skuSeq}, #{instructedQty}, COALESCE(#{pickedQty}, 0), #{remark})
mapper.update:
UPDATE tb_outbound SET outbound_status = #{toStatus},
shipped_by = #{actor}, shipped_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
canceled_by = #{actor}, canceled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, cancel_reason = #{cancelReason},
updated_by = #{actor}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE outbound_seq = #{outboundSeq} AND outbound_status = #{fromStatus}
